title: Florida total dengue cases top 1,000, more than 600 locally acquired - Outbreak News Today
text:
Florida total dengue cases top 1,000, more than 600 locally acquired 
 Subscribe Sign in North America Florida total dengue cases top 1,000, more than 600 locally acquired
 Robert Herriman Nov 13, 2026 1 Share Florida state health officials reported 100 additional autochthonous dengue fever cases during the week ending November 7.
 This brings the total locally transmitted cases to 624 year to date.
 12 counties have reported local transmission - Brevard, Broward, Citrus (3), Hillsborough (468), Manatee (2), Miami-Dade (16), Orange (14), Palm Beach, Pasco (6), Pinellas (109), Polk, and Seminole (2).
 In addition, 40 travel associated dengue cases were reported this past week, bringing the total cases to 422 from 26 counties, Miami-Dade County reporting the most with 271.
 The combined total of locally acquired and travel associated cases stands at 1,046.
